primary.role: primary buttons, headlines, primary action color

secondary.role: secondary buttons, secondary text, UI chrome

accent.role: single warm accent — pricing emphasis, loved feedback, active itinerary card, hover states

background.role: page background — slightly warm off-white (paper, not snow)

surface.role: cards, forms, raised surfaces — one notch warmer than background

muted.role: captions, drive times, timestamps, helper text
